LayerPreset.title: LayerPreset
LayerPreset.description: 2D artboard transform, fill color, and optional compressed artwork for front, back, or lanyard layer.

fitMode.description: How uploaded artwork fits the artboard bounds.

backgroundColor.description: Hex fill color for the layer base.

lanyardRepeat.description: Pattern repetition count along the 80cm strap (1 to 8).

uploadedFileName.description: Original filename of uploaded artwork, or empty string when using procedural template.

artworkDataUrl.description: Compressed data URL (WebP/JPEG/PNG) of uploaded artwork, or empty string for procedural template.

StudioPresetConfig.title: StudioPresetConfig
StudioPresetConfig.description: Complete 3D ID card, lanyard, protective case, material finish, and lighting configuration.

cardCaseEnabled.description: Whether the rigid protective badge holder case is enabled.

cardCaseStyle.description: Material style of the protective badge holder.

hardwareFinish.description: Metallic finish for lobster clasp, swivel barrel, and crimp.

hologramEnabled.description: Whether the iridescent security foil overlay is enabled.

showLanyard.description: Whether the 80cm woven lanyard and metallic clasp are shown.

CardPreset.title: CardPreset
CardPreset.description: User-generated link-shareable 3D ID card and lanyard preset stored for cross-device loading and interaction.

title.description: Display title for the ID card preset.

description.description: Optional short note describing the preset.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the preset creator.

authorName.description: Public display name of the creator (no email or PII).

isPublic.description: When true, anyone with the direct link (?preset=<id>) can load and interact with the 3D ID card.

thumbnailDataUrl.description: Compact front-card JPEG preview thumbnail data URL.

UserQuota.title: UserQuota
UserQuota.description: Atomic per-user preset counter enforcing the maximum presets-per-user cap without storing PII.

presetCount.description: Current number of active saved presets owned by this user (0..10 for standard users, 0..100 for admins).

lastPresetId.description: Document ID of the preset atomically created or deleted in this batch.

updatedAt.description: Server-generated timestamp of the last atomic quota update.

AdminRole.title: AdminRole
AdminRole.description: Console-managed moderation role marker granting preset review and takedown permissions.

role.description: Elevated moderation role granted exclusively via the Firebase Console.

/presets/{presetId}.description: User-generated 3D ID card & lanyard presets (link-only public access via get; owner/admin list).

/users/{userId}.description: Atomic per-user preset quota counter updated in batches alongside preset create/delete.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Console-managed admin role allowlist for content moderation and takedown.
